claim: The owner, of Gravesend's railway carriage: build a vehicle you can enter out of red (two-sided) sectors with a ceiling of floor-aligned solid sprites, and do not lower a parallax sky over it, which looks bad from outside. We built it as hull sectors 256 thick with their floors at roof height, a window as a hull stretch whose floor sits at the sill, the door as a stretch whose floor sinks, the inside as a room under the common sky, and a roof of floor-aligned solid sprites (cstat 32|1|256) at the hull's top.
evidence: The owner, 2026-11-19, kept in projects/blood-city/level/l3_station.py:195-199: 'Carriage can be made out of red sectors and ceiling can be made out of floor aligned solid sprites, this will make it working without lowering sky which looks bad from the outside'
use: projects/blood-city/level/l3_station.py is the worked example; lay the roof with bloodmap.flatsprite.cover.
